Backend pytest 14/14 PASS covering /interested (no-visit + with-visit + notifications), /attending-admins (super/office/staff all 200 returning only super+office roles), /visit PATCH (assign valid admin, staff-id → 400, clear, all status transitions, invalid status → 400, staff → 403/404), /convert (with full payload → student created with course+college and notes containing 'City: ...', lead.conversion_details set, whatsapp+visit_whatsapp both ok:False with detail — expected for safe phone 0000000000; NO-body backcompat call still returns 201; idempotent second call returns already_converted with same student_id). WA safety: every test used phone 0000000000 and the Interakt 'Phone Number & Country Code provided is invalid' response is treated as PASS per spec. Frontend (Playwright super_admin → /leads → 'All leads' tab): created QA WA Test leads, opened detail, clicked Interested chip → interested-dialog opens with parent/alt inputs + visit tick; ticking reveals departure/arrival/travel/who/drop inputs; submit shows lead-visit-panel with badge='Scheduled' + visit-wa-status='WhatsApp not sent' (expected). Visit management: visit-attending-select loaded 9 admins, picking one saved silently; clicking visit-status-chip-admitted flipped badge to 'Admitted'. Convert flow: convert-dialog opens with convert-city-select (5 options from /api/colleges), convert-course-select (8), convert-college-select (1 after cascading), convert-link-preview visible ('Link (referral link) → 0000000000'), submit created student — detail's lead-converted-note shows 'B.Sc. NURSING - NELAMANGALA · SRI SIDDARTHA MEDICAL COLLEGE & HOSPITAL · Bangalore'. Board view toggles to leads-view-board and back. Staff regression (staff.blr@kmfoundation.online): no crm-tab-all, no leads-uncategorized-toggle, no lead-campaign-assign, no visit-attending-select on assigned leads (also no visit yet on their leads). Staff still sees lead-status-chip-* including Interested/Converted — the capture-dialog intercept works for staff too because backend accepts staff on /interested (edit permission) and rejects only /visit PATCH.
critical_code_review_comments: InterestedDialog / ConvertDialog correctly gate WhatsApp toast messaging on the {ok, detail} envelope returned by /api/leads/... — a WA failure is surfaced as toast.warning without blocking the flow (visit still saved). Good separation.

LeadDetailDialog uses __autoAction to bridge board→dialog opening of Interested/Convert capture forms — clean pattern that avoids two code paths. Consider clearing __autoAction on onOpenChange(false) so re-opening the same lead doesn't re-fire (minor: the effect depends on `lead` object identity, and setDetailLead(null) on close prevents the loop, so this is currently safe).
convert_lead endpoint uses Optional[ConvertIn] = None so legacy no-body calls keep working. Also correctly builds student notes with 'City: <val>' only when city provided, matching UI expectation.

attending-admins endpoint scopes only to role in (super_admin, office_admin) and approval_status=approved — office admin from another office IS returned in the dropdown for a super admin (by design: super admin can pick any office admin to attend). If cross-office attendance shouldn't be allowed, this endpoint would need office filtering — worth confirming with product.

_schedule_visit sets visit.whatsapp_sent based on send_visit_scheduled's ok flag; the doc is stored under lead.visit (single visit per lead). If a lead needs multiple visits later, the schema will need to become an array — mention in ARCH note.

Frontend: buildApplyUrl in ConvertDialog produces '/ref=<userId>' preview when refId exists; backend uses referrer_user_id which is lead.assigned_to_user_id — matches the spec 'apply.kmfoundation.co.in/ref=<assignee>'.
